name: character-wheel-picker
title: Character Wheel Picker
description: A slot-machine you drive: up/down arrows (or wheel) spin each character column independently through the alphabet with inertial easing, composing text letter by letter — an input mechanism, not an animation.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Wheel And Key Input: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
